description: This file contains utility functions for memory management, process execution, attribute validation, and attribute handling within the rdkssa component. It also includes unit test code for these functions.

methods.name: rdkssa_memwipe
methods.description: Clears a block of memory by setting it to zero.

methods.name: rdkssa_memfree
methods.description: Wipes memory and frees the pointer, then sets it to NULL.

methods.name: rdkssaCleanupVector
methods.description: Frees an array of strings and sets the pointer to NULL.

methods.name: rdkssaExecv
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments, handling process creation and waiting.

methods.name: rdkssaExecvPipeOutput
methods.description: Executes a command with output redirection via pipe, with callback processing.

methods.name: rdkssaAttrCheck
methods.description: Validates attribute string for length and bad characters.

methods.name: attributeHandlerHelper
methods.description: Handles attribute strings, matches them against a table, and calls associated functions.

methods.name: rdkssaHandleAPIHelper
methods.description: Processes multiple attributes by invoking attribute handlers.
